description: Source code defining classes and functions for segmentation model components, including DETR-based segmentation, mask head, attention, and post-processing for masks and panoptic outputs.

classes.name: DETRsegm
classes.description: Segmentation head class based on DETR architecture, predicting masks and bounding boxes.

classes.name: MaskHeadSmallConv
classes.description: Convolutional head for mask prediction with upsampling and group normalization.

classes.name: MHAttentionMap
classes.description: 2D attention module returning attention softmax weights.

classes.name: PostProcessSegm
classes.description: Post-processing for segmentation masks, resizing and thresholding.

classes.name: PostProcessPanoptic
classes.description: Converts model outputs into panoptic segmentation format, including mask merging and image generation.

methods.name: _expand
methods.description: Utility function to expand a tensor along a new dimension and flatten.

methods.name: dice_loss
methods.description: Calculates the DICE loss for mask similarity.

methods.name: sigmoid_focal_loss
methods.description: Calculates the focal loss used in dense detection models like RetinaNet.
